reuse.why: Changes the existing shared getScheduledAmount and replaces schedule-template's own inline average with a call to it.

duplication.why: Removes the last inline copy of the range rule; no logic is duplicated.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module every server and client consumer already imports it from.

scope.why: Helper change, the one call-site consolidation, tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: A single definition now owns the ranged-amount rule; only a stale 'average' comment in Balance.tsx is left untouched.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts createScheduleList now uses getScheduledAmount instead of bypassing it.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by forecast, schedules app, budget schedule-template and the client tables/balance.
